title: Data Analyst Advanced Roadmap
summary: A focused plan to deepen analytical expertise, build a standout portfolio, and prepare for senior‑level roles. Combines advanced techniques, leadership skills, and interview readiness.

phases.title: Foundations Refresh
phases.summary: Reinforce core tools and concepts to ensure a solid base for advanced work.

milestones.title: Advanced Spreadsheet Modeling
milestones.outcome: Create dynamic, error‑checked models using array formulas and data validation.

tasks.title: Review array formulas
tasks.description: Read the Google Sheets array formula guide on support.google.com and practice with sample data.

tasks.title: Build a financial model template
tasks.description: Design a multi‑sheet budgeting model with drop‑down selectors and conditional formatting.

tasks.title: Practice data validation rules
tasks.description: Apply custom validation to prevent entry errors in a sales tracker spreadsheet.

tasks.title: Reflect on model audit steps
tasks.description: Write a short checklist of audit steps for spreadsheet accuracy.

milestones.title: SQL Query Mastery
milestones.outcome: Write efficient, window‑function queries on large relational datasets.

tasks.title: Study window functions
tasks.description: Read the PostgreSQL window functions chapter on docs.postgresql.org and note use cases.

tasks.title: Build a churn analysis query
tasks.description: Using a public Kaggle dataset, write a query that calculates monthly churn with LAG and LEAD.

tasks.title: Practice query optimization
tasks.description: Run EXPLAIN on your query and add indexes to improve runtime.

tasks.title: Connect with a SQL community
tasks.description: Join the r/SQL subreddit and share your query for feedback.

milestones.title: Statistical Foundations Review
milestones.outcome: Explain hypothesis testing concepts and calculate confidence intervals manually.

tasks.title: Read hypothesis testing overview
tasks.description: Review the hypothesis testing section on Khan Academy (free).

tasks.title: Calculate p‑values in Excel
tasks.description: Use built‑in functions to compute p‑values for a two‑sample t‑test on sample data.

tasks.title: Build a confidence interval calculator
tasks.description: Create a small Python script (no pandas) that outputs a 95% CI for a mean.

tasks.title: Reflect on assumptions
tasks.description: Write a brief note on the assumptions behind each test you performed.

phases.title: Core Skills Deepening
phases.summary: Develop expert‑level abilities in Python, visualization, and storytelling.

milestones.title: Python + pandas for Complex Transformations
milestones.outcome: Manipulate nested JSON, perform time‑series resampling, and create reusable pipelines.

tasks.title: Read pandas advanced indexing
tasks.description: Study the MultiIndex section on pandas.pydata.org and take notes.

tasks.title: Build a data cleaning pipeline
tasks.description: Write a Python script that ingests raw JSON logs, normalizes fields, and outputs a tidy CSV.

tasks.title: Practice vectorized calculations
tasks.description: Replace a loop with pandas vector operations on a large sales dataset.

tasks.title: Connect with a pandas meetup
tasks.description: Attend a free virtual meetup listed on meetup.com and discuss best practices.

milestones.title: Interactive Data Visualisation
milestones.outcome: Create interactive dashboards that let stakeholders explore data on their own.

tasks.title: Learn Plotly basics
tasks.description: Follow the introductory tutorial on plotly.com/python and reproduce examples.

tasks.title: Build an interactive sales dashboard
tasks.description: Using Plotly Dash, develop a dashboard with filters for region, product, and time range.

tasks.title: Practice chart‑type selection
tasks.description: Swap chart types in the dashboard and evaluate readability for each stakeholder persona.

tasks.title: Reflect on UX choices
tasks.description: Write a short critique of the dashboard’s user experience and note improvements.

milestones.title: Storytelling with Data
milestones.outcome: Craft compelling narratives that turn analysis into actionable decisions.

tasks.title: Read storytelling guide
tasks.description: Read the free “Storytelling with Data” PDF summary and highlight key principles.

tasks.title: Create a slide deck narrative
tasks.description: Turn the interactive dashboard into a 10‑slide deck that tells a clear story.

tasks.title: Practice presenting to peers
tasks.description: Record a 5‑minute presentation and get feedback from a colleague via Slack.

tasks.title: Connect with a data storytelling forum
tasks.description: Post your deck on the Data Visualization subreddit for critique.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Assemble portfolio projects that showcase end‑to‑end analytical expertise.

milestones.title: Sales Dashboard Project
milestones.outcome: Deliver a polished, interactive dashboard from a public dataset.

tasks.title: Select public sales dataset
tasks.description: Download the “Retail Sales Forecasting” dataset from Kaggle.

tasks.title: Clean and model data in pandas
tasks.description: Apply the pipeline built earlier to prepare the data.

tasks.title: Create interactive dashboard
tasks.description: Use Plotly Dash to build the final dashboard with filters and KPI cards.

tasks.title: Write project documentation
tasks.description: Draft a README that explains data source, methodology, and insights.

tasks.title: Publish to GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Deploy the dashboard and add a link to your portfolio site.

milestones.title: A/B Test Analysis Write‑up
milestones.outcome: Produce a rigorous statistical report with clear business recommendations.

tasks.title: Obtain A/B test dataset
tasks.description: Use the “AB Testing” dataset from Kaggle.

tasks.title: Perform hypothesis testing in Python
tasks.description: Write a script that calculates lift, confidence intervals, and p‑values.

tasks.title: Visualise results with Plotly
tasks.description: Create side‑by‑side bar charts showing control vs variant metrics.

tasks.title: Draft executive summary
tasks.description: Summarize findings in a 1‑page memo aimed at senior leadership.

tasks.title: Seek feedback from a mentor
tasks.description: Share the report with a senior analyst for critique via email.

milestones.title: Cohort Retention Report
milestones.outcome: Deliver a cohort analysis that uncovers retention drivers and visual trends.

tasks.title: Load cohort data in pandas
tasks.description: Import a churn dataset from a public source and create cohort groups.

tasks.title: Calculate retention curves
tasks.description: Write pandas code to compute month‑over‑month retention percentages.

tasks.title: Visualise with heatmap
tasks.description: Use seaborn to plot a retention heatmap with annotations.

tasks.title: Write insights section
tasks.description: Identify three actionable insights and write them in plain language.

tasks.title: Add to portfolio site
tasks.description: Create a dedicated project page with screenshots and code snippets.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish leadership abilities, master senior‑level interview topics, and finalize the portfolio.

milestones.title: Leadership & Impact
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate ability to lead analytics initiatives and mentor junior analysts.

tasks.title: Read leadership case studies
tasks.description: Read two Harvard Business Review articles on data‑driven decision making (free versions).

tasks.title: Design a mentorship plan
tasks.description: Outline a 3‑month coaching schedule for a junior analyst, including weekly topics.

tasks.title: Practice stakeholder briefing
tasks.description: Simulate a 10‑minute briefing to a mock executive panel (record yourself).

tasks.title: Reflect on leadership style
tasks.description: Write a brief journal entry on strengths and growth areas as a data leader.

milestones.title: Senior Analyst Interview Prep
milestones.outcome: Confidently answer technical, case, and behavioral questions for senior roles.

tasks.title: Review common case studies
tasks.description: Study three senior analyst case studies on Glassdoor and outline solution frameworks.

tasks.title: Mock technical interview
tasks.description: Schedule a 60‑minute live coding interview on SQL and pandas with a peer.

tasks.title: Practice behavioral STAR stories
tasks.description: Write STAR responses for leadership, conflict, and impact examples.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback
tasks.description: After each mock interview, note three improvement actions.

milestones.title: Portfolio Polish & Job Search
milestones.outcome: Launch a professional portfolio site and execute a targeted job search strategy.

tasks.title: Design portfolio layout
tasks.description: Use a free template on GitHub Pages to showcase projects with clear titles and metrics.

tasks.title: Add interactive project demos
tasks.description: Embed live dashboards or GIFs for each portfolio project.

tasks.title: Optimize LinkedIn profile
tasks.description: Rewrite headline and summary to highlight data storytelling and senior impact.

tasks.title: Connect with recruiters
tasks.description: Send personalized messages to 10 data‑analytics recruiters on LinkedIn.

tasks.title: Reflect on job search plan
tasks.description: Create a weekly tracking sheet for applications, interviews, and follow‑ups.
